dict.string: Agent-Desk uses automation to identify the foreground app and browser, pause supported media while you dictate, and let the assistant operate your apps for you.
Agent-Desk uses Accessibility to paste dictation and read selected text for Voice Action.
Agent-Desk records the other participants' audio only while you record a meeting, and keeps it on this Mac.

Agent-Desk reads your calendar on this Mac to remind you before meetings, title their recordings, and answer the assistant's questions about your day. Only what a request needs goes to your assistant.
Agent-Desk reads your reminders on this Mac when you ask the assistant about them. Only what a request needs goes to your assistant.

Agent-Desk looks up people in your contacts on this Mac when you ask the assistant to call, write, or invite someone. Only what a request needs goes to your assistant.
Agent-Desk uses your microphone for private local dictation and does not store the captured audio.
